reason: H0 still exercises the materially changed lossy-VP8 decoding path through wuffs_webp__decoder and fuzz_image_decoder. In S1, decoder.do_decode_image_config_limited? derives QUIRK_SOURCE_LENGTH from the input-controlled sub_chunk_length and calls this.vp8.set_quirk! before this.vp8.decode_image_config?, satisfying the new VP8 API protocol. After configuration, fuzz_image_decoder queries workbuf_len, allocates that exact maximum, and calls decode_frame, reaching the new partition copying, entropy parsing, and frame-decoding behavior. The new validation statuses and direct-VP8 quirk edge cases do not create a material gap for this WebP harness.
evidence: H0 initializes wuffs_webp__decoder and passes its base.image_decoder upcast to fuzz_image_decoder.
S1 decoder.do_decode_image_config_limited? calls this.vp8.set_quirk!(key: base.QUIRK_SOURCE_LENGTH, value: ((this.sub_chunk_length as base.u64) << 1) | 1) for this.is_vp8_lossy.
H0 fuzz_image_decoder calls decode_image_config before querying wuffs_base__image_decoder__workbuf_len, so S1 workbuf_yuv_v_end and partitioned_data_length are established before allocation.
H0 allocates workbuf_len(dec).max_incl and passes workbuf to decode_frame, which in S1 invokes copy_partitions_to_workbuf?, decode_first_partition!, and decode_other_partition_lengths!.
Input bytes control the WebP sub_chunk_length and the limited VP8 source consumed by the new parsing code.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit; retain H0.
